say:1:1130505001:1.text: Ah, looking closer I can see you're not part of the usual rabble.
say:1:1130505001:1.source_cn: 哦，仔细看看你确实和那些人不太一样。
say:1:1130505001:1.male: Ah, looking closer I can see you're not part of the usual rabble.
say:1:1130505001:1.female: Ah, looking closer I can see you're not part of the usual rabble.

say:2:1130505002:1.text: I don't know where the legend of the treasure came from, but more and more treasure hunters have arrived and are driving the locals mad.
say:2:1130505002:1.source_cn: 不知道是哪传出来的宝藏传说，越来越多的寻宝人来到这里，...
say:2:1130505002:1.male: I don't know where the legend of the treasure came from, but more and more treasure hunters have arrived and are driving the locals mad.
say:2:1130505002:1.female: I don't know where the legend of the treasure came from, but more and more treasure hunters have arrived and are driving the locals mad.

say:3:1130505003:1.text: I can already tell you aren't like those scoundrels.
say:3:1130505003:1.source_cn: 你并不像那些混蛋，俺可以看出来。
say:3:1130505003:1.male: I can already tell you aren't like those scoundrels.
say:3:1130505003:1.female: I can already tell you aren't like those scoundrels.

say:4:1130505004:1.text: In any case, beware of the Quicksand Claws.
say:4:1130505004:1.source_cn: 无论如何，小心流沙之爪。
say:4:1130505004:1.male: In any case, beware of the Quicksand Claws.
say:4:1130505004:1.female: In any case, beware of the Quicksand Claws.
